status: pre-fix physical animated software-fallback capture; superseded by the static clock handoff candidate

recording.notes: Contains the frozen origin, approximately 11 seconds of visible software-fallback motion, then the frozen origin after the Freeze origin benchmark control. The active interval estimate comes from the timed physical interaction, not decoded animation telemetry.

diagnosticSamples.interpretation: Exploratory samples suggest high CPU use and low screenrecord capture cadence. Screenrecord cadence is not a reliable application FPS measurement, and gfxinfo returned no frame rows for this software-rendered host. Treat this as an adverse diagnostic signal that needs a better controlled motion-performance measurement, not as a formal budget result.

limits: Synthetic local package fixture, one physical device, software-rendered Android host. This proves motion is visible during the recorded interval only; it does not prove a frame-rate budget, parity with hardware/web/iOS, production app acceptance, or published-package behavior. The CPU/cadence signal is concerning but not a thresholded acceptance result.
